versions.content: The Os Low Proxy shall create one TimingEvent per configured SwCluCOsProxyDispatcherTimingEvent container in the partition specific Service Software Component according [SWS_SwCluC_02272]. The attributes of the TimingEvent shall be set as following: • shortName is set according the container's shortName • startOnEvent is set to the RunnableEntity according [SWS_SwCluC_02273] related to the owning SwCluCOsProxyOsTaskDis- patcher container 123 of 715 Document ID 974: AUTOSAR_SWS_SoftwareClusterConnection Specification of Software Cluster Connection module AUTOSAR CP R21-11 • period value is set according the SwCluCOsProxyTimingEventPeriod pa- rameter • disabledMode (s) are created according the SwCluCOsProxyDisabledMod- eInstanceRef (s) where for each different PPortPrototype an RPortPro- totype is created at the owing Service Software Component according [SWS_SwCluC_02272] and used as contextPort .
